result.title: PRISM: Validation-Free Online Batch Selection for LLM Fine-Tuning via Preconditioned Conic Ghost Matching
result.summary: Online batch selection lowers the cost of fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) by replacing each candidate batch with a smaller informative subset. Existing selectors typically depend on a held-out validation or proxy set, or else rely on Euclidean facility-location objectives over unpreconditioned gradients whose diameter-shifted similarities are distorted by heavy-tailed gradient norms and cross-layer anisotropy. We introduce PRISM (Preconditioned Ray-Isotropic Submodular Matching), a validation-free online batch selector that aligns candidate gradients in a factored second-moment metric and casts subset construction as conic facility location over positive ray projections. Computing the required pairwise geometry through factored preconditioned ghost inner products avoids materializing per-example parameter gradients, while the conic objective remains normalized, nonnegative, and monotone submodular---guaranteeing a $(1-1/e)$ greedy approximation whose additive error scales with total batch gradient energy rather than the worst-case outlier diameter. Assigning each candidate to its best-aligned selected ray induces closed-form radial projection weights that automatically shrink orthogonal or noisy examples toward zero. We derive a nonconvex convergence bound showing that optimization error is governed directly by the conic representation cost. Across four LLM fine-tuning configurations spanning 1.5B to 8B parameters, PRISM outperforms full-batch training, Euclidean facility location, and zeroth-order selectors, and rivals or surpasses validation-guided baselines without held-out data.

AI.brief_summary: PRISM 提出无需验证集的在线批次选择：在预条件二阶矩度量下对齐候选梯度，将子集构造写为射线锥上的设施选址子模问题，借助分解的 ghost 内积避免逐样本梯度物化，并给出 (1-1/e) 贪心近似与非凸收敛界，在 1.5B–8B 规模 LLM 微调上优于全批与欧氏设施选址等基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其预条件度量下的子模设施选址与闭式射线投影权重（自动压低正交或噪声样本），可能可供核查用于视觉证据或候选 latent 假设的筛选与加权；但论文面向通用 LLM 微调数据选择，未涉及多模态推理状态，联系属推测。
